source_record.description:
Company 

TransPerfect Language & Cultural Training is part of the TransPerfect solutions, the world’s largest language service and technology solutions provider for global businesses with offices in more than 100 cities around the globe. 

Position details 

TransPerfect is currently looking for an English language trainer in Paris (and nearby area), to join our team of language professionals. As an English language trainer with TransPerfect, you will deliver language classes to our clients from a variety of sectors and cultural backgrounds. 

Responsibilities 

Main Objectives 

• Prepare lesson plans and deliver effective training 

• Be prepared to develop complementary course materials to meet learners’ needs 

• Assess language levels 

• Create language content 

• Engage learners in the learning process and keep motivation levels high 

• Monitor progress and evaluate learners’ performance throughout the course 

• Apply TransPerfect’s teaching methodology and be prepared to adjust lessons to different culturally-based learning styles 

• Take part in TransPerfect’s Language Trainer development plans and additional training 


Education and Experience 

• Native or native proficiency in English 

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent 

• Minimum of 3 years' experience teaching English 

Preferred Skills 

• Knowledge of the corporate business environment 

• Knowledge of a second language 

Details 

• Location: Paris

• Timetable: September 2026

• Contract: Freelance
